sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI announced the official $2 input and $10 output rates for grok-2-vision-1212 on its launch page dated Dec 12, 2024.
The official model configuration represents cached prompt pricing as one field and gives it zero for the grok-2-vision-1212 example; it does not define a cache-write price.

notes: The source material supports the $2/$10 base rates but gives no evidence that xAI ever charged a separate $10 cache-write rate; its API model schema uses a single cached-prompt price field instead. No primary source found states or brackets when models.dev removed that field, and the Wayback CDX endpoint returned HTTP 503, so the effective date is unknown.
